title: Title
excerptNotebookRequired: Select an excerpt notebook in settings first
extHint: Install unpacked Chrome extension folders (with manifest.json), CRX / ZIP extension packages, or paste an extension link from the Microsoft Edge Add-ons site (microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons) to download and install it directly. Content scripts are injected into web pages opened in browser tabs; background/popup are not executed, so some extensions may not fully work. Reload tabs after installing.
extEdgePlaceholder: Edge Add-ons URL or extension ID, e.g. https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/...
excludedSitesDesc: Matching URLs open in system default browser instead of plugin. One hostname per line, matches the domain and its subdomains. Lines starting with # are comments.
extNativeTip: Electron native extension runtime (session.loadExtension), content scripts injected by Chromium
extShimTip: Shim mode: plugin simulates content script injection with limited chrome.* APIs
extBackgroundWarn: This extension depends on a background page (background/popup are not executed in this host), so it may not work. Network-blocking extensions like AdGuard cannot function here.
adBlockRulesDesc: The ad filter is element hiding (CSS injection) only — no network blocking; built-in rules cover common ad networks and sites like tgb.cn. Reload tabs after changes. Rule syntax matches Adblock: ##selector applies to all sites; domain##selector applies to that domain (and subdomains); domain#@#selector is an exception. You can paste the element-hiding (##) part of lists like EasyList China.
excerptNotebookInvalid: The excerpt notebook does not exist or is closed, please re-select it in plugin settings
